text:
maria: FYI CI linkcheck is failing on the notebooks examples page right after the mkdocs -> docusaurus migration. Error shows a missing fragment. dev-bot: CI alert: docs/linkcheck failed (exit 1) - https://ci.redwood/links/9001 Error: 404 on /docs/notebooks#examples-notebook-snippets sam: Ah, we renamed that H2 to 'Notebook examples' during conversion and the slug changed. /guides/data-science still links to the old #examples-notebook-snippets anchor. nina: Easiest fix is reintroduce the legacy anchor on the notebook page. You can add an explicit MDX id: `## Notebook examples {#examples-notebook-snippets}` or raw HTML: `

Notebook examples

`. maria: Let's avoid changing the visible header text. Adding the explicit id is non-breaking for readers. sam: I'll open a tiny PR that adds the id and also updates the migration guide with a recommendation to keep old anchors. liam: Could we also teach the linkcheck to ignore a short allowlist of legacy fragments for one deploy? I don't want the whole CI to keep failing while we fix a few pages. nina: Yeah we can add an `ignoredFragments` array in the linkcheck config and remove it after the fixes land. But prefer landing the page-level anchor. sam: I'll do both: land the anchor in the page and temporarily add the fragment to the linkcheck ignore list. maria: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/812 - adds `{#examples-notebook-snippets}` to docs/notebooks.mdx and a short note in docs/migration/mkdocs-to-docusaurus.md under "Heading/anchor changes". dev-bot: Created tracker issue #501: restore legacy anchors for notebook/examples links - https://tracker.redwood/501 sam: Running `yarn docs:linkcheck` locally — passes. Pushing for CI run. dev-bot: CI linkcheck on PR/812 build 5631 - passed ✅ liam: Great, please add a release note: "Preserve legacy heading anchors for notebook examples to avoid broken external links." maria: Added release-note stub in the PR description and backported the MDX change to the `migration-guide` branch. nina: Suggested tiny wording change on the migration doc to include both the HTML and MDX examples. maria: Wording updated and merged. Closing this thread. :white_check_mark:
